mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity can impair flecainide clearance via renal dysfunction, while flecainide's cardiac effects may be potentiated by aminoglycoside-induced electrolyte abnormalities and QT prolongation risk.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and flecainide levels; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; perform baseline and serial audiometry if prolonged aminoglycoside therapy required.
